question: Are the most minute measures of time recognized as divine?
premises: The kāṣṭhā receives salutation as a divine form.
The lavas receive salutation as divine forms.
The measures receive salutation as divine forms.
inference: Even the smallest measures of time are encompassed within the divine.
plain_english: Salutation to the kāṣṭhā, salutation to the lavas, salutation to the measures.
